summary: "Chain of thought" began as an everyday English phrase for a connected sequence of ideas or reasoning, used for decades in literature, history, and science writing. Since 2022 it has mostly meant a technique in which large language models generate intermediate reasoning steps before answering, first as a prompting method and now as a trained-in feature of reasoning models.
